claim: Netflix's Q4 2023 revenue topped $9.5 billion for the first time.
summary: Netflix's reported Q4 2023 revenue was about $8.83 billion, not above $9.5 billion, so it did not top $9.5 billion in Q4 2023 and therefore did not do so for the first time then; the $9.5 billion level was first exceeded in 2024 without tools no evidence can be cited, but known earnings contradict the claim.

sub_claims.text: Netflix's Q4 2023 revenue was greater than $9.5 billion
sub_claims.note: Known earnings release for Q4 2023 (reported Jan 2024) showed revenue ~$8.83 billion, below $9.5 billion.

sub_claims.text: Q4 2023 was the first time Netflix quarterly revenue exceeded $9.5 billion
sub_claims.stated_text: topped $9.5 billion for the first time
sub_claims.note: Since Q4 2023 did not exceed $9.5 billion, it cannot be the first time above that threshold; $9.5 billion was first exceeded in 2024.
